q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is on August 26, 2026. Today is August 22, 2026.
**Time remaining: 4 days**

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's **forward guidance** (not actual results) issued at the Q2 FY2027 earnings release. The research provides highly specific data:

- NVIDIA issued guidance on May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027 of **$91.0 billion ±2%** (range: $89.2B to $92.8B)
- Wall Street consensus is **$91.9 billion**
- Q2 guidance implies 11% sequential growth
- The upcoming earnings (Aug 26) will reveal actual Q2 results AND new forward guidance for Q3 FY2027

The question is asking for the **forward guidance** in the earnings release, which would be guidance for Q3 FY2027 (the next quarter), not confirmation of the Q2 guidance already issued.

NVIDIA typically provides sequential guidance at each earnings call. Given:
- Q2 guidance was $91.0B ±2%
- Q2 implied 11% sequential growth from Q1
- Historical pattern shows NVIDIA providing sequential quarterly guidance

The forward guidance (Q3 guidance) would reasonably be in the range of $100-105B if growth continues at similar or slightly slower rates. However, the research explicitly states "Investors will closely watch the forward guidance for Q3 FY2027, as it often influences the stock more than the reported quarter," confirming that new forward guidance will be provided.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Softening demand signals in data center market
- China restrictions impacting revenue more severely than expected
- Market saturation concerns emerging
- Competitive pressure from AMD or other AI chip makers
- Macro headwinds affecting enterprise AI spending
- Sequential growth decelerating more sharply than the 11% Q2 pace

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected demand for AI accelerators and GPUs
- Successful new product launches (e.g., Blackwell)
- Cloud providers accelerating capex cycles
- Automotive and enterprise AI applications ramping faster
- International demand offsetting China restrictions
- Margin expansion allowing aggressive pricing power

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides:
- Q2 FY2027 guided revenue: $91.0 billion ±2% ($89.2B–$92.8B)
- Q1 FY2027 implied approximately $82.3B (backing from 11% sequential guidance)
- YoY growth: ~100% (Q2 FY2026 was $46.7B)

No reliable base rate for typical forward guidance ranges in the provided sources, but the Q2 guidance range gives directional context.

---

## Reasoning

The question asks about "forward guidance" in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26. This means NVIDIA will provide guidance for Q3 FY2027 at that earnings call.

Given:
- Q2 revenue guidance: $91.0B ±2%
- Sequential growth pace: 11% from Q1 to Q2
- If growth moderates slightly (to 8-10%) or remains steady (10-12%), Q3 guidance would be approximately **$99B–$103B**
- Very strong growth (12%+) would suggest **$102B–$105B+**
- Significant slowdown (<8%) would suggest **$95B–$99B**

The range provided ($99.5B–$115.5B) spans from modest continued growth to exceptionally strong acceleration. The midpoint of $107.5B would imply ~18% sequential growth—higher than Q2's 11% pace but possible if momentum accelerates.

Most likely, NVIDIA will guide conservatively in line with recent patterns and provide Q3 guidance in the **$101B–$105B** range (representing 11-15% sequential growth), well within the provided range but clustered in the lower-middle portion.

The upper bound of $115.5B would require 27% sequential growth—historically high but not impossible if AI demand exceeds expectations.

The lower bound near $99.5B would suggest decelerating growth to 9% sequential, possible but conservative given recent momentum.

**Best estimate for forward Q3 guidance: ~$103B** (midpoint of likely range, representing ~13% sequential growth)

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is set to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8). For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, projected revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China, a stance continued from the year-ago quarter [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).

Wall Street analysts, according to Yahoo! Finance, have an average revenue estimate of approximately $91.9 billion for Q2 FY2027, falling within NVIDIA's guided range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This implies a year-over-year revenue doubling compared to the $46.7 billion in the same quarter last year [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). The upcoming report will also clarify the sequential growth pace, as the Q2 guide implies an 11% sequential increase, down from 20% in Q1 FY2027 [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Investors will closely watch the forward guidance for Q3 FY2027, as it often influences the stock more than the reported quarter [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).
